slots.ev: 下雨天不營業，她在門口貼紙條
slots.pl: 宜蘭老屋一樓的花店，下雨天，門關著，她正在門上貼紙條
slots.pl_en: at the front door of the flower shop on the ground floor of the old house in Yilan on a rainy day, the shop shut and a note going up on the glass
slots.ac: 她兩手把紙條按在門上，其中一隻手上有被刺傷的小傷口
slots.ac_en: She is pressing the note flat against the door with both hands, one of them marked with a small thorn cut.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下雨天不營業，直接在門口貼紙條／手上常常有被刺傷的小傷口
slots.wall_ok: 門上那張她自己寫的紙條是場景的一部分，守則不得禁止它
slots.of: 米白色的棉質長洋裝，外面罩一件霧綠色的薄外套
slots.of_en: an off-white cotton dress with a misty green light jacket over it
slots.li: 她站在門內側，雨天的灰白光從門外過來，店裡沒開燈所以她這一面暗
slots.li_en: She is on the inside of the door with the grey-white rainy light coming from outside it, and with nothing switched on in the shop her own side is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「低飽和、霧面、潮濕。宜蘭的雨是她的固定配角」
slots.fa: 很淡，看著自己貼的那張紙
slots.fa_en: Very mild, looking at the note she has just put up.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：貼文從來不超過十個字
slots.hair_en: down and slightly damp from the rain

slots.ev: 洗完澡上樓，濕頭髮還貼在鎖骨上
slots.pl: 老屋二樓的浴室，白天，舊磁磚，高窗的光從一側進來
slots.pl_en: in the second-floor bathroom of the old house in the daytime, old tiles, light from a high window coming in from one side
slots.ac: 她靠著磁磚牆，一手撐在洗手台邊，濕頭髮貼在鎖骨上
slots.ac_en: She is leaning against the tiled wall with one hand on the edge of the basin, her wet hair stuck to her collarbone.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：剛洗完澡的濕髮貼在鎖骨上
slots.of_s: 私下核心：白色棉質吊帶／色盤：米白
slots.li: 高窗的日光從一側進來，浴室另一側落暗，畫面允許過曝
slots.li_en: Daylight from the high window comes in from one side, the other side of the room falls away, and the picture is allowed to blow out a little.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「自然光為主，允許過曝與失焦」
slots.fa_en: Very light, looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：像自言自語被聽見了
slots.hair_en: wet and stuck to her collarbone

slots.ev: 雨天樓上把窗開著，那隻不知道誰的貓在地板上
slots.pl: 老屋二樓的木地板房間，下雨天，窗開著，一隻貓趴在旁邊
slots.pl_en: in the wooden-floored room on the second floor of the old house on a rainy day, the window open and a cat lying nearby
slots.ac: 她赤腳盤腿坐在木地板上，兩手擱在膝上看著貓
slots.ac_en: She is sitting barefoot and cross-legged on the wooden floor, hands resting on her knees, watching the cat.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：店裡永遠有一隻不知道誰的貓／私下核心：赤腳
slots.of: 淡粉色的棉質吊帶配寬鬆長褲
slots.of_en: a pale pink cotton camisole with loose trousers
slots.li: 雨天的窗光從側面進來，房間深處是灰的，對比很低
slots.li_en: Rainy-day window light comes in from the side, the far side of the room goes grey, and the contrast is very low.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「低對比、顆粒感」
slots.fa_en: Almost no expression, watching the cat.

slots.ev: 雨停了走去鎮上的雜貨店，屋簷下還有人在躲

ppl.act: 也在屋簷下躲雨、跟店裡的人講話
ppl.wear: 小鎮居民的日常衣服，雨鞋、薄外套

slots.pl: 宜蘭小鎮一間老雜貨店的屋簷下，雨剛停，地上還有水窪
slots.pl_en: under the eaves of an old grocery shop in a small Yilan town just after the rain has stopped, puddles still on the ground
slots.ac: 她一手提著一小袋東西站在屋簷下，正要走出去
slots.ac_en: She is standing under the eaves with a small bag in one hand, about to step out.
slots.of: 灰色的長版針織外套，裡面是米白的
slots.of_en: a grey long knit cardigan over something off-white
slots.li: 雜貨店的燈從店裡打到屋簷下，街上暗，水窪把光反回來
slots.li_en: Light from inside the shop reaches under the eaves, the street beyond is dark, and the puddles throw it back.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「宜蘭的雨是她的固定配角」
slots.fa_en: Very quiet, looking out at the street.

slots.ev: 夜裡樓上只開一盞，她就這樣待著
slots.pl: 老屋二樓她睡的房間，夜裡，只開了床邊那一盞
slots.pl_en: in the room she sleeps in on the second floor of the old house at night, only the lamp by the bed switched on
slots.ac: 她赤腳蜷在床上，一隻手臂枕在頭下，另一隻攤在身前
slots.ac_en: She is curled barefoot on the bed with one arm under her head and the other laid out in front of her.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：她本來就這樣待在自己家裡
slots.of: 白色的棉質吊帶配同色短褲
slots.of_en: a white cotton camisole with matching shorts
slots.of_s: 私下核心：白色棉質吊帶
slots.li: 床邊那一盞燈在她側前方很低，房間其餘部分暗，畫面保留顆粒
slots.li_en: The lamp by the bed sits low and to one side of her, the rest of the room is dark, and the grain is left in the picture.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「低對比、顆粒感」
slots.hair_en: down and dry, spread on the pillow
